# We are Funnel

Funnel is the leading marketing intelligence platform for marketing and data teams. Since its founding in 2014, Funnel has grown to more than 300 employees across offices in Stockholm, Boston, Hamburg and Sydney. Today it serves more than 3,000 mid-market and enterprise businesses around the globe.

## The product

Marketing teams have more data than ever. The hard part is knowing which numbers to trust.

Funnel brings all your marketing data together and puts it to work, from reporting and AI agents to marketing mix modeling (MMM). Data Hub collects and prepares dependable data from 600+ sources. Measure builds on it with MMM, incrementality testing and budget optimization.

Marketing data you can depend on, available wherever your business needs it.

[Read more](https://funnel.io/product-overview)
